summary: Vylor Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of Corteva's separation of its seed operating segment into an independent NYSE-listed company (VYLR), effective 12:03 a.m. October 1, 2026. Corteva shareholders of record September 24, 2026 received a pro rata distribution of all Vylor shares. EIDP contributed 100% of Pioneer Hi-Bred International in exchange for 667,302,930 new Vylor shares, a ~$761 million cash distribution to EIDP, and Vylor's assumption of portions of EIDP's 2.300% 2030, 5.125% 2032 and 4.800% 2033 senior notes tied to exchange offers. Watch distribution mechanics, debt assumption and post-spin index inclusion.
